scenes.text: Read the question carefully, list the needed quantities, choose operations in order, then check units.
First add 14 and 39, then multiply the result by 2. The answer is 106. (14 plus 39) times 2 equals 106.
A classroom for a school fundraiser has 35 blue counters and 26 red counters in each box. There are 3 boxes. How many counters altogether? Pause the video and think.
A classroom for a school fundraiser has 35 blue counters and 26 red counters in each box. There are 3 boxes. How many counters altogether? The answer is 183. (35 plus 26) times 3 equals 183.
